//: Feature 31, the Fairy Queen's ONE bargain (pack Prompt 46). Offered while hw_stat_queen_bargain is 0 (the marker, hidden 0/1, rate 0: once a run). It trades only vanilla and Harsh Wilds stats and items: the accept answer is shown only while vanilla Stamina (1cfd30cf13b69b949a0ac521f55a59a2, 0 to 32, base rate +2 a tick) is at least the price, then takes 16 Stamina (a night's dancing), lowers vanilla Stress (3b79a4c6d7e151044a1c56fbbd401d78, base rate -0.25; a fall moves it away from vanilla Tgr_Anxiety's 240, never into it) by 40, gives one Harsh Wilds mistletoe (hw_mistletoe, the sprig the realm's own wander finds at 10 percent), and sets the marker. No SpendTicks: the answer takes no time, so the realm's stay clock cannot cut it off. Decline leaves the offer open for the next visit. NextStep 2 = DialogStep.ExitDialog. Every number (16 Stamina, 40 Stress, one sprig) is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER.

Line.DefaultText: You look so tired, traveller. Dance with my court until the music stops, and I will take your cares away and give you a sprig of mistletoe to keep.

Answer.DefaultText: I will dance with your court.
